# Android QEMU payload

This preview uses unmodified QEMU guest/CPU logic from the official Termux aarch64 packages, with ELF library names and runpaths adjusted for installation inside this APK. `packages.json` pins original package filenames and SHA-256 digests. `bundle.json` records the installed ELF files and digests.

Recreate the payload on Linux (Python 3.12+, binutils/readelf):

```sh
python3 -m pip install patchelf==0.19.1
python3 scripts/prepare_qemu.py
./gradlew assembleDebug
```

The script verifies every downloaded package, extracts an ARM64 QEMU executable and the transitive ELF dependency closure, renames the libraries to Android-installable `.so` filenames, patches DT_NEEDED/SONAME/runpaths with patchelf, and copies PC BIOS files. Android installs this executable with its package manager, rather than executing downloaded code from app-writable storage. Native payload files are generated into app/src/main/jniLibs/arm64-v8a and are not checked into the source snapshot. The custom 1.44 MB boot-test floppy is generated by the same script.

## Corresponding sources and notices

- QEMU 11.1.3, GPL-2.0-or-later: https://gitlab.com/qemu-project/qemu/-/tree/v11.1.3 (clone with submodules for ROM sources), https://download.qemu.org/qemu-11.1.3.tar.xz
- Termux build environment, package sources, patches and build recipes: https://github.com/termux/termux-packages/tree/d4e5b905c5582a33cd77922a9b7bb4f05b80104c . All selected packages, versions and upstream homepages are listed in packages.json. QEMU and firmware come from the qemu recipe; dependency sources and patches are in their package recipes. Follow each recipe's TERMUX_PKG_SRCURL and version for its upstream source, with the listed Termux patches. No modifications to the upstream CPU or device implementation were made here.
- Original copyright/license notices extracted from those packages are retained in licenses/.
- noVNC 1.6.0, primarily MPL-2.0: https://github.com/novnc/noVNC/tree/a8dfd6a3ea3c74244f5ebdaa5a7f1023007a7820 . Its readable JavaScript source and individual license notices are bundled in app/src/main/assets/novnc, including vendor notices.
- Android-x86 5.1-rc1 is downloaded separately from its official SourceForge project, never included in the APK. See https://www.android-x86.org/source.html for source/build instructions. Its ISO SHA-256, independently calculated from the downloaded 375390208-byte file, is b0d5470b88a030ebc7715a3bdabb9ca7c5dad8b476430a98f3c0fb668e041a6d.

## Preview limits

Only arm64-v8a hosts have the new QEMU payload. Guest architecture is x86; ARM APK translation is not implemented. TCG software emulation is used, not KVM or privileged containers. The display is an offline noVNC client connected only to loopback. Audio/networking and persistent guest storage are intentionally absent from this first Live-ISO preview. An Android boot is not implied by the self-test: it only executes a small custom BIOS boot sector. Device execution and performance still need testing on the user's phone.
